findings.note: _atomic_write_bytes fsyncs file contents before os.replace but never fsyncs the containing directory after the rename. Consequently, a hard crash can persist a live-target rename without durably persisting the preceding journal rename, or lose PRE-image directory entries while retaining the journal. That permits an unrecoverable or undetected mixed generation and does not satisfy the transaction contract's crash-safe, all-or-nothing journal and recovery guarantees.
